name: Shadow Street, Northern End
desc1: This wide, litter-cluttered street is paved with broken and chipped
desc2: flagstones. Tall, rickety buildings tower above on either side of the
desc3: street, their barred and curtained windows disquietingly watchful.
desc4: Flickering light is provided by lit torches fastened to the walls. To
desc5: the west, a large wooden door stands, a sign with a picture of a
desc6: candle inscribed on it hanging above. The street continues to the
desc7: south, and empties onto a small plaza to the north.
